name: Silt Strider authored journal titles
notes: Almost every journal quest names itself: a response with quest_status 'name' carries the title. 676 of 758 vanilla topics and 2455 of 2577 Tamriel Rebuilt topics do.
Most that do not are not quests at all -- Blades contact notes, book-reading entries, a developer test -- and carry no completion state, so they need no title.

That leaves 3 in vanilla and 15 in Tamriel Rebuilt that can be completed but never name themselves. Only titles that can be verified against the game are authored here; the rest publish name null with the first journal entry as fallback text, because inventing a quest name is worse than showing the player the real words.

The one exception is the official plugins' quests, by the user's decision on 2026-09-22. They were made before Tribunal added quest names and finish flags, so the game never names them and nothing can be verified against it; their titles are UESP's names for them, from its quest pages Morrowind:Siege at Firemoth (quest), Morrowind:Master Index (quest) and Morrowind:Helm of Tohan (quest).
Add an entry here when you can confirm a title. The builder fails if a key named here is not an untitled quest in some profile, so a stale entry cannot sit unnoticed.
